About

Get to Know Me

B.Sc Computer Science student from Karur, Tamil Nadu. I speak Tamil and English.

B.Sc CSArasu College
2Internships

I'm Yuga Shree, a creative freelancer and aspiring front-end developer with a passion for design, technology, and digital creativity.

I enjoy working across different creative fields, including video editing, poster designing, digital marketing, and content creation.

Alongside my creative interests, I explore front-end development and UI/UX design to build responsive, attractive, and user-friendly digital experiences.

I believe creativity has no limits, and every project is an opportunity to learn something new.

My goal: to pursue a career in content creation and software development, using my creativity and problem-solving skills to contribute to innovative projects while I keep learning and strengthening my coding expertise.

About these posters

These posters are recreation practice pieces. I take a reference poster, study its layout, typography, colours and hierarchy, and then rebuild it from scratch in my own workflow. It trains my eye for composition, sharpens my design tools, and helps me match a client's reference or brand style.

Process

How I Work

A simple, transparent four-step process so you always know what happens next.

01

Discover

We start with a short chat to understand your goals, audience, deadline and any reference material you have.

OutcomeA clear project brief
02

Plan

I outline the concept, structure and timeline, and we agree the scope and number of revisions before work begins.

OutcomeConcept, scope and timeline
03

Create

I design, edit or build the work and share progress so you can give feedback early, not at the end.

OutcomeDraft ready for your review
04

Deliver

I apply the agreed revisions, check the final output and hand over the files in the formats you need.

OutcomeFinal files, ready to use

FAQ

Good to know

What services do you offer?

Poster and graphic design, video editing, social media content, digital marketing ideas, UI/UX design and front-end web development.

Which tools do you use?

DaVinci Resolve and CapCut for video; Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator and CorelDRAW for design; Adobe XD for UI/UX; and HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Python for development.

How long does a project take?

It depends on the scope. Tell me what you need and I will share a realistic timeline before we start.

Do you accept revisions?

Yes. We agree on the revisions during planning, then I refine the work until it fits.

How can I contact you?

Email, call or WhatsApp me using the buttons at the bottom of this page, or use the contact form.
